name: Awesome Spyware Detection
description: A curated list of tools, indicators, investigations, and resources for detecting and exposing spyware and stalkerware.

tag_legend.unmaintained: No commit or release in two or more years.
tag_legend.niche: Small community script with limited support.
tag_legend.requires root: Needs root or jailbreak for its main functionality.

items.name: androidqf
